### Jeroboam I Breaks the Covenant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jeroboam-breaks-the-covenant
Passage: 1 Kings 12:25-33
Points:
- Jeroboam allowed political anxiety to dictate religious practice rather than relying on God's promise.
- Fearing the loss of his throne, he established rival worship sites and golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
- His actions repeated Aaron's golden calf transgression by substituting human convenience for God's commanded sanctuary.
- Attempting to preserve authority through disobedience provokes divine judgment and eventual ruin.
- Believers must trust the promises revealed in Scripture instead of manufacturing worldly solutions.

### Bible Pathway - Apr. 26, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-apr-26-2010-11629382.html
Passage: 1 Kings 12:26-31
Points:
- Jeroboam allowed insecurity and selfish ambition to dominate his decisions after the kingdom split.
- He established unauthorized shrines at Bethel and Dan to prevent people from traveling to Jerusalem.
- In defiance of divine law, he installed non-Levitical priests to manage his counterfeit worship system.
- Replacing God's commandments with comfortable, convenient alternatives ensnares others in sin.
- Followers of God must stay grounded in Scripture to guard against modern spiritual compromises.
